title: pi-click-sidebar configuration
description: Validation aid for <agent-dir>/pi-click-sidebar.json. The extension enforces the same rules at runtime (src/config.ts): a missing field keeps its default, an out-of-range number is clamped, and an unknown key is reported once and ignored.

$schema.description: Published schema URL. Ignored by the extension's own validation.

mode.description: auto follows the dock probe; off loads the extension and does nothing.

dockMinTerminalWidth.description: Below this terminal width the dock hides and the rail takes over.

refreshIntervalMs.description: Refresh tick period. The default is 6000 ms because the shortstat tick measures ~86 ms on a 6000-file repository with 800 dirty paths (docs/03-architecture.md §5).

showFileList.description: Start with the changed-file section expanded.

accentOverride.description: Forces a concrete accent, bypassing the theme. Documented contrast risk.

timeouts.description: Per class of command, in milliseconds.
